solutions.title: Flatten and merge
solutions.strategy: Flatten all busy intervals, sort by start, and record gaps between merged busy ranges.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Flattened intervals are stored before merging.

solutions.title: Min heap stream
solutions.strategy: Push each employee's first interval into a heap, streaming intervals by start time and recording gaps.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each interval enters and leaves a heap of E employees once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The heap stores at most one interval per employee.
